target.title: Apply Claw plugin artifacts
target.body:
## Summary

Stacked on #101973 and RFC openclaw/rfcs#27.

This is the next mutating Claws PR in the updated sequence: real plugin artifact apply plus direct-user versus Claw ownership integration.

- adds `src/claws/artifact-installers.ts` to run supported Claw plugin artifacts through the existing `openclaw plugins install` command path during `claws apply --yes`
- records direct-owner and created-by-Claw ownership hints in Claw artifact provenance
- preserves direct-user ownership as a separate owner in `refCount`
- updates `plugins uninstall` so direct uninstall of a plugin still referenced by a Claw releases only direct ownership and leaves plugin files/config installed
- fails artifact apply if the delegated plugin installer does not produce the expected installed-plugin record
- updates lifecycle E2E to prove real local plugin install + workspace file apply + provenance in one `claws apply --yes` flow

## Stack

- RFC: openclaw/rfcs#27
- validation PR: #101328
- mutating PR 1: #101755
- mutating PR 2: #101973
- this PR: mutating PR 3, plugin artifact installers and shared ownership

## Validation

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts

git diff --check
node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs
```

Full `pnpm exec tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` reaches the known unrelated baseline error:

```text
src/secrets/config-io.ts(12,17): error TS4058: Return type of exported function has or is using name 'configWritePostCommitRollback' from external module "/root/src/openclaw-claws-pr5-installers/src/config/io" but cannot be named.
```

## Real behavior proof

The updated lifecycle E2E invokes the real CLI with `node --import tsx src/entry.ts` and proves:

```text
claws apply <temp-local-plugin-claw.json> --yes --workspace <temp-workspace> --json
```

The fixture writes a local plugin directory with `package.json`, `openclaw.plugin.json`, and `dist/index.js`; `claws apply` delegates to the existing plugin installer, writes `SOUL.md`, records one Claw artifact ref, and returns `openclaw.clawApplyResult.v1` with `recordedArtifactRefs: 1`, `appliedWorkspaceFiles: 1`, and `provenanceRecords: 2`.

## Not in this PR

- skill installer execution remains preview/provenance-only
- Claw-level `remove`, rollback execution, and final artifact cleanup remain for the next lifecycle PR
- automation enablement remains preview-only
